tabs.html:
D CORE OT-E1001G – 1GE EPON ONU (ZTE Chipset)

The D CORE OT-E1001G is a high-performance 1GE EPON Optical Network Unit (ONU) designed for Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) deployments. Powered by a reliable ZTE chipset, it provides a cost-effective solution for delivering high-speed internet access to residential and small business users.

Key Features:

  • EPON Standard Compliance: Fully compliant with IEEE 802.3ah, ensuring broad compatibility with various EPON Optical Line Terminals (OLTs).
  • ZTE Chipset: Utilizes a ZTE chipset known for stability and efficiency in data processing.
  • 1GE Port: Includes one 10/100/1000 Mbps auto-negotiation Ethernet port for high-speed data transfer.
  • Optical Interface: Comes with an SC/UPC single-mode fiber connector, supporting symmetric data rates of 1.25Gbps for both upstream and downstream.
  • Long Distance Transmission: Supports communication over distances of up to 20 kilometers between the ONU and the OLT.
  • Low Power Consumption: Operates on 12V DC with power usage around 2W, making it energy-efficient.
  • Compact Design: Small form factor (approximately 110 x 80 x 25 mm) for flexible installation in various environments.

Typical Applications:

  • Home Internet Access: Provides stable and fast broadband connectivity.
  • Small Office Networking: Ideal for connecting multiple users in a small office setting.
  • Triple-Play Services: Supports services like IPTV, VoIP, and high-speed internet.

Package Contents:

D CORE OT-E1001G ONU device

12V DC power adapter

Quick installation guide
